title: Vallée says there are protocols for leaving the cave

tellings.quote: And I asked Jacques Valle this. I said, "Are there protocols?" And he said, he's like, "Yes, there are."

plain: The UFO researcher Jacques Vallée is said to have confirmed that there are "protocols" for leaving "the cave". The cave is Plato's allegory of the cave, an old Greek story about prisoners who take shadows on a wall for the whole of reality. Michels tells it as his own exchange: he asked Vallée whether such protocols exist and says Vallée answered, "Yes, there are," though Michels does not say what they are.
